title: Sr. Manager Accounting Operations
text:
Nova Biomedical: One Global Brand. One Vision. Together under one name.

Advanced Instruments and Nova Biomedical are now united under one brand, Nova Biomedical, marking a major milestone in our journey to deliver greater value to our customers. By combining our strengths, we're accelerating innovation, supporting critical workflows, and delivering world-class service across the biopharmaceutical and clinical markets.

**Job Summary:**

The Sr. Manager Accounting Operations leads the organization’s payables and receivables functions, ensuring accurate and timely transaction processing, effective cash management, strong internal controls, and excellent service to internal and external stakeholders. This role manages daily operations, develops team capability, drives process improvements, and partners across Finance, Procurement, Sales, Customer Service, and other functions to resolve issues and support business objectives.

**Responsibilities:**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Leadership and team management:** Lead, coach, and develop Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable staff; establish priorities, clarify responsibilities, monitor performance, and foster a collaborative, accountable, and service-oriented culture.
* **Accounts Payable:** Oversee invoice processing, approval workflows, vendor maintenance, payment runs, employee expense reimbursements, and issue resolution while ensuring payments are accurate, timely, properly authorized, and compliant with company policies.
* **Accounts Receivable:** Oversee customer invoicing, cash application, account reconciliation, collections, credit administration, dispute resolution, and aging review to support timely cash conversion and minimize past-due balances.
* **Travel Management:** Lead global adoption and upkeep of SAP Concur, manage global travel policy, partner with global travel management vendor, liaise with Treasury on credit card solutions and integrations to Concur and ERP, and reconcile related balance sheet balances and accruals.
* **Close and reconciliation:** Ensure timely completion of monthly, quarterly, and year-end close activities, including subledger reconciliations, accrual support, aging analysis, and resolution of reconciling items.
* **Controls and compliance:** Maintain strong internal controls, segregation of duties, and complete documentation; support internal and external audits and ensure adherence to applicable accounting standards, tax requirements, and company policies.
* **Cash flow and reporting:** Monitor payables and receivables trends, prepare cash requirement and collection forecasts, and provide accurate metrics and analysis to Finance leadership.
* **Process improvement:** Identify and implement opportunities to standardize, automate, and streamline processes; strengthen data quality, cycle time, scalability, and the stakeholder experience.
* **Systems and master data:** Support effective use of ERP, banking, expense, and workflow systems; maintain accurate vendor and customer master data and participate in system implementations or enhancements.
* **Business partnership:** Collaborate with Procurement, Operations, Sales, Customer Service, Treasury, Tax, and other partners to address root causes, resolve escalated issues, and improve end-to-end processes.
* **Risk management:** Implement controls that reduce fraud, duplicate payments, unauthorized transactions, bad debt, and credit exposure; escalate significant risks promptly.
* Develop, document, and maintain policies, procedures, service standards, and business continuity plans for both functions.
* Perform other responsibilities and special projects as assigned.

**Experience Requirements:**

* Seven or more years of progressive experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, accounting operations, or a related field, including at least three years of people leadership experience.
* Demonstrated knowledge of invoice-to-pay and order-to-cash processes, general ledger interfaces, reconciliations, month-end close, internal controls, and audit support.
* Experience with ERP and financial systems; advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort using reporting and workflow tools.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build effective relationships across functions and with customers and vendors.
* High degree of accuracy, integrity, discretion, and sound judgment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
* CPA, CMA, CAPP, CICP, or other relevant professional certification preferred.
* Experience in a multi-entity, multi-currency, manufacturing, life sciences, or similarly complex operating environment preferred.
* Experience with shared services, system implementation, process automation, or continuous improvement methodologies preferred.
* Experience in SAP S/4HANA, SAP Concur preferred.

**Physical Requirements and Working Conditions:**

* Comfort with working at a computer for extended periods.

* Capacity to lift and carry up to [25–50] pounds as required

* Able to communicate effectively via phone, video, and written communication.

* Occasional need to move about the office to access meetings or resources.

**Why Work for Nova Biomedical**

* Flexible Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage
* Competitive 401k company match
* Bonus Program, Generous PTO and paid holidays
* Generous Tuition reimbursement
* Hybrid and flexible work arrangements
* Professional development, engagement and events
* Company marketplace for lunch and snacks in our Norwood, MA, Billerica, MA and Westbrook, ME offices
* Company subsidized cafeteria in our Waltham, MA office

**Work Location:** Hybrid in **Waltham, MA**

**Targeted Salary Range:** **$180,000-$220,000/yr**

Nova Biomedical believes in transparency and integrity throughout all we do, including compensation. The provided salary range for this role represents the expected base salary or hourly rate for this opening. Actual compensation will be commensurate with the candidate’s experience and may vary based on individual factors such as location, skills, and education.
 
 
About the company

At Nova Biomedical, we’re not just building instruments, we’re powering breakthroughs that improve lives. Our smart, science-driven solutions are trusted in over 100 countries to speed drug development and enhance patient care.

Our integration brings together more than 70 years of scientific excellence with Nova’s cutting-edge innovation, forming a powerhouse of precision, purpose, and possibility. With FDA-registered, ISO-certified manufacturing, more than 125 FDA approvals, and industry-trusted diagnostics, we’re setting new standards in quality and reliability. Nova Biomedical is proud to be a global leader in osmolality testing and biotechnology and in vitro diagnostic (IVD) instrumentation, dedicated to advancing patient care and scientific discovery with a legacy that continues to shape the future of life sciences.

With headquarters in Norwood and Waltham, Massachusetts, and a global team of nearly 2,000 employees, we’re building a collaborative, empowered culture grounded in shared values: Customer Centricity, Ingenuity, Ownership & Accountability, Collaboration, and Integrity.

Working at Nova Biomedical means joining a mission-driven organization where your contributions matter. Whether you're in engineering, science, manufacturing, or support, you’ll be part of a team that values innovation, invests in your growth, and is committed to making a real-world impact on global health.

Explore what’s next with us at novabiomedical.com
